data.long_meaning: The radiant one, the luminous one, derived from the Arabic root raa-q-ah, meaning to shine, radiate, or be bright. The name Raiqah carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Raiqah usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
